title: Your First Weekend at Colorado College, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Kick Off at NSO Check-In
cards.subtitle: Pick up your Gold Card and keys
cards.notes: Start your weekend by heading to the arena to collect your student ID, room keys, and orientation materials. This is the official first stop for all new Tigers.
cards.short_summary: The primary check-in hub for New Student Orientation (NSO) and move-in logistics.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student move-in and NSO check-in take place at Ed Robson Arena starting at 8:00 am on move-in Monday.
cards.access_notes: Open for check-in from 8:00 am to 12:00 pm on designated move-in days.

cards.title: Welcome Lunch on the Grass
cards.subtitle: Refuel with fellow new families
cards.notes: After moving into your dorm, walk over to the central quad for a relaxed outdoor lunch under the orientation tents. It is a great spot to meet your first few classmates.
cards.short_summary: The central campus green space used for major orientation gatherings and social events.
cards.evidence_claim: A Welcome Lunch is held on Tava Quad from 11:00 am to 1:00 pm following morning move-in.
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space; lunch event specifically for new students and families.

cards.title: Dinner at 'Rasty'
cards.subtitle: Experience the community hub
cards.notes: Swipe your Gold Card for an all-you-care-to-eat dinner. Visit the stir-fry station or the pizza oven while meeting people in the college's main social dining space.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining facility located within the Worner Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rastall Dining Hall is the main cafeteria where students swipe their Gold Card for meals, featuring multiple food stations.
cards.access_notes: Standard dinner hours are 5:00 pm to 7:00 pm; requires a meal plan swipe or payment.

cards.title: Explore with your Priddy Group
cards.subtitle: Local service and exploration
cards.notes: Join your small group of 10-12 peers for a half-day of community service or a local hike. This tradition helps you bond with your first CC 'family.'
cards.short_summary: A signature orientation program involving small-group service and outdoor activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Priddy Experience involves small groups participating in service, local, and outdoor programs during orientation week.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Education - Priddy Experience - Colorado College
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; locations vary by group assignment.

cards.title: Hike the Red Rocks
cards.subtitle: Iconic Colorado Springs scenery
cards.notes: Take a short 10-minute drive or a college shuttle to see the massive sandstone formations. It is the quintessential first-weekend outdoor excursion for CC students.
cards.short_summary: A public park featuring dramatic red rock formations and numerous hiking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Garden of the Gods is a 10-minute drive from campus and is a frequent destination for student field trips and recreation.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 5:00 am to 9:00 pm; free admission to the park.

cards.title: Get Creative at Worner
cards.subtitle: Late-night making and DIY
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of Worner to try your hand at ceramics or fiber arts. It is a low-pressure way to spend a Friday afternoon or evening with new friends.
cards.short_summary: A co-curricular studio space offering non-graded art-making opportunities for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arts and Crafts Studio is located in the lower level of Worner Campus Center and offers classes and open studio time.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday until 7:30 pm, Fridays until 5:00 pm, and Sundays 2:00 pm-5:00 pm.

cards.title: Late Night at the Rink
cards.subtitle: Themed skating at Robson Arena
cards.notes: Check the weekend digest for themed skate nights. It is a popular late-night activity where you can rent skates and hit the ice with the campus community.
cards.short_summary: Periodic themed ice skating events held at the campus hockey arena.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night Skates are coordinated by Campus Activities at Robson Arena, typically on Friday or Saturday nights.
cards.access_notes: Occurs periodically; check the OCA Instagram or Weekend Digest for specific dates and times.

cards.title: Art Break at the FAC
cards.subtitle: Free museum access for students
cards.notes: Show your student ID for free entry to the museum galleries. It is a quiet, air-conditioned escape just a block away from the main campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: A major regional art museum and theatre that is a division of Colorado College.
cards.evidence_claim: Colorado College students receive free museum admission to the Fine Arts Center with their student ID.
cards.source_title: Tickets – Fine Arts Center - Colorado College

cards.title: Find Your Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Late-night prep for Block 1
cards.notes: Explore the four floors of the library to find your favorite spot before classes start. The fourth floor stays open late for those who need a quiet workspace.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library, designed to support the intensive pace of the Block Plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Tutt Library offers regular block hours until 12:00 am, with the fourth floor remaining open until 2:00 am.
cards.access_notes: Gold Card required for entry after 6:00 pm; 4th floor open until 2:00 am during blocks.

cards.title: Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: The official start of the year
cards.notes: Gather with the entire campus community on Monday morning to officially kick off the academic year. It is a formal tradition that marks the end of your first weekend.
cards.short_summary: A historic Norman Romanesque chapel used for major college ceremonies and traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation is a CC tradition held in Shove Memorial Chapel to welcome new students and kick off the academic year.
cards.source_title: Join Us for Opening Convocation on Monday, Aug. 24 - Today@CC
cards.access_notes: Event typically starts at 9:00 am on the first Monday of Block 1.
